messages:
jules: FYI we locked a narrow POC with FinSec Co. starting May 4. They require SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC sync to our app roles, and domain controls for email allowlist.

rami: Good. Need to clarify: are they expecting SCIM incremental provisioning or full sync each run? Also ask if they need SCIM over mTLS or if bearer token is fine.

anya: Their security questionnaire flagged SCIM audit logs and SCIM rate limits. We should surface typical throughput (users/min) we support during POC. Recommend we propose 2000 updates/min for dedicated POC (burst ok).

jules: Price question: they want a 6-week POC, reserved capacity at peak (2x standard). Salesops, what's the max credit AE can promise?

salesops: AE can promise up to 40% usage credits and $7k engineering hours credit pre-approved. Anything beyond needs RevOps approval.

rami: Integration notes: SP metadata URL + ACS will be provided by us. We support SHA256 signatures and attribute mapping. Example SAML attrs we map: email, givenName, familyName, uid. We also accept custom attribute mapping if IdP provides.

anya: Security-bot: Please attach the standard SAML/Security PDF.

security-bot: [automated] SAML and SCIM security brief attached (link). Cert rotation window: 30 days recommended; we support manual rotation and can automate via API.

jules: They also need nested groups -> role expansion. We flatten nested groups and can include group path in SCIM group displayName. Mention this to them.

rami: SCIM example payload snippet for user create:
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "userName": "jdoe@finsec.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "John", "familyName": "Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value": "jdoe@finsec.com"}]
}
Token header: Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>

anya: Blocker: customer legal requires DPA + SCCs and a clause for certified encryption at rest. We can provide DPA template and our SOC2 cert. Legal may ask for subprocessor list — that's doable but may add 3-5 days.

jules: Action items: 1) Rami send SP metadata + sample ACS and SCIM token process, 2) Anya assemble throughput and security packet, 3) Salesops confirm credit and reserved capacity by EOD Fri.

salesops: Noted. I'll escalate to RevOps if they request >40% credit or dedicated GPU instances for the POC.

jules: I'll ask the customer whether mTLS is mandatory and whether they prefer IdP-initiated SSO. Also confirm estimated active users during POC (~200-1500?).

rami: I'll stand up a POC environment on Dedicated with SCIM sandbox and provide endpoints.

anya: I'll start the sec questionnaire draft and include retention windows for SCIM logs and cert rotation docs.

jules: Thanks everyone — will sync next Tue after we get vendor metadata. :calendar:
